summary: Never exited: the trade whipsawed in a shallow -8 to +6 pt band with giveback% swinging wildly (7% to 68%) on tiny legs, but ER10 stayed low most of the frames (pure chop, not a persistent trend against the position), and drawdowns never exceeded the noise band established in the first few minutes. By the end px was hovering near flat/slightly negative with no clean directional break. Next time I'd watch for a sustained ER10 rise above ~0.5 combined with 3+ consecutive against-fires and a giveback% that keeps climbing across multiple legs (not just one) as the actual exit trigger, rather than reacting to single-frame giveback spikes on small-amplitude legs.
